sections.theory:
(a) Diwan al-'Aziz:

Its head was the chief vizier. The work of this department was to supervise the other departments.

(b) Diwan al-Kharaj:

The work of this department was to keep account of the income and expenditure of the government. This very department also supervised kharaj, zakat, jizyah, 'ushr and other taxes. Keeping their account too was the responsibility of this department.

(c) Diwan al-Rasa'il or Kitabat:

In the era of the Banu Abbas this department had great importance. This department wrote royal decrees, treaties and the replies to the letters of foreign rulers. Intelligent, able and calligraphist people were recruited in this department.

(d) Diwan al-Barid:

This was the department of post. The post was sent by means of fast horses. Pigeons too were used. The chief officer of this department was called Sahib al-Barid. This department also kept the caliph informed of provincial affairs.

(e) Diwan al-Ahdath:

This was the department of police. Its work was to maintain peace and order in the country. The head of this department was called Sahib al-Shurtah. Later it was given the status of a vizier.
